chapter_title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy b

fills.notes: Fits the sequence of the first war: seizure → binding by the Living Soul; standard cosmological constraint (immobilization of the adversary’s motions after separation).
The Enemy is “gathered into the fetter” as into a receptacle matching his own archetype (his primordial form/state). The pre-institutional register prefers this spatial/containment phrasing.
The “rolling back” is explicitly an eschatological reversal occurring “at the end,” when the mixed is undone and separated into its own kinds.
Sexual division is expressed as a separation of contraries in ultimates; the wording is tightly constrained by the antithetic pair male/female.

Oppositional fate: the male fixed/bound in a lump (mass, coagulum); the female cast down into the tomb (receptacle of generation). The verb of forcible casting matches the punitive correspondential sense.

The clause requires (1) an act of closure/confinement, then (2) the means: “by a great stone in their midst,” yielding perpetual separation ‘generation upon generation’. This keeps the impersonal cosmological register (no judicial speech), and supplies the missing verbal hinge between “it will be divided” and “stone.”
Refers back to the agents of Light accomplishing the final confinement: the binding is an effected, irreversible state; the repetition (“achieved… achieved”) is characteristic of this teaching style.

assessment: Most gaps are formulaic and tightly constrained by the three-war scheme (capture/binding; melting/reconstitution into the archetypal fetter; final separation of contraries). Only ¶4 #4 required a substantive reconstruction to bridge the syntax; the sense is clear (perpetual confinement by a separating stone), but exact wording remains tentative.
